g) Acoustic enclosure h) Transportation upto Site i) Unloading and dismantling of the Diesel Generator at Site j) Commissioning Supply installation, testing and commissioning of 40 KVA, 3 phase, 415V AC, Silent DG Set compri sing of Engine, with minimum 51 BHP, at 1500 RPM, coupled with alternator of same make mount ed on a common base frame complete with above requirements. The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Undertaking to this effect must be submitted with this bid. 3. Latest OEM authorization certificate must be submitted. 4. Latest ISO:9001 certificate must be submitted. 5. Latest MII certificate mentioning % of local content and place of value addition must be submitt ed. 6. BIS certificates as applicable must be enclosed. 7. IP Certificate of the Control Panel 8. Bidder Turnover and OEM turnover documents, duly attested by a registered Charted Accounta nt (CA), as defined in the bid document must be submitted. 9. Bidders must satisfy the experience criteria and past performance as defined in the bid and the documents related to same (Copy of contract with respective invoice duly signed by the buyer / C RAC) must be submitted. 10. Bidders must have registered service centres at Thrissur District. * Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents soug ht in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. .
